string.name: nearlink_reason

string.name: location_reason

string.value: Exercise app · not an official alert

string.name: language_failed

string.name: theme_system

string.name: alert_expired

string.name: verify_failed

string.name: init_failed

string.name: bundled_points
string.value: Selected points from the PSP dataset

string.name: map_description
string.value: Central Kraków, stored offline. Points are also available as a list.

string.name: access_notice

string.name: save_failed
string.value: Could not save the point. Try again.

string.name: saved_load_failed

string.name: distance_notice

string.name: demo_origin
string.value: Reference: Rynek Główny (demo), not your location.

string.name: location_ready
string.value: Location updated. Distances use this measurement.

string.name: location_permission_denied

string.name: location_disabled

string.name: location_unavailable

string.name: location_outside_pack

string.name: location_poor_accuracy

string.name: relay_intro
string.value: Connect to receive and automatically relay signed alerts.

string.name: no_radio
string.value: This test runs on one device without radio transmission.

string.name: nearlink_notice
string.value: Radio delivery needs compatible physical phones. NearLink has not been tested on physical devices.

string.name: guide_intro
string.value: Based on Poland’s public safety guide. Follow current instructions from the authorities.

string.name: guide1_body
string.value: Check the entrance and access before an emergency. A map point does not confirm that a place is open or safe to reach.

string.name: guide2_body
string.value: Prepare an evacuation bag and a household plan. Account for personal needs. Charge your phone and power bank.

string.name: guide3_body
string.value: Follow evacuation instructions when issued. Check that neighbours know about the alert and tell loved ones your plan.

string.name: guide4_body
string.value: Keep SafeMesh on screen during the test. Delivery requires a connected neighbouring device.

string.name: trust_body
string.value: The signature is checked against the SafeMesh exercise key. This app does not receive official RCB alerts.

string.name: trust_limits
string.value: Verification needs an accurate clock. A relay limit does not prevent a malicious device from changing the hop count.

string.name: external_links
string.value: Source links need internet. The map and guide work offline.

string.name: queue_note
string.value: A receipt confirms app delivery, not that a person read the message or who they are.

string.name: persistence_load_failed
string.value: Saved alerts could not be loaded.

string.name: persistence_save_failed
string.value: Verified, but not saved. The message is only in app memory.

string.name: hardware_unsupported
string.value: NearLink is unavailable on this device.

string.name: hardware_off
string.value: Enable NearLink in phone settings, then start relaying.

string.name: hardware_available
string.value: NearLink support detected. Connect a compatible phone.

string.name: hardware_ready
string.value: NearLink ready. Search by the other phone’s name.

string.name: hardware_permission_denied
string.value: NearLink access denied. Check nearby-device permissions.

string.name: hardware_stopped
string.value: Relay stopped. Saved messages remain available.

string.name: hardware_error
string.value: NearLink failed. Check permissions and radio settings.

string.name: hardware_restore_failed
string.value: Relay paused: saved messages could not be read.

string.name: hardware_cleanup_failed
string.value: Could not stop all operations. Restart the app.

string.name: hardware_load_alert
string.value: Load a valid exercise message first.

string.name: hardware_queued
string.value: Messages queued. Waiting for app receipts.

string.name: hardware_queue_error
string.value: Delivery paused because of an error.

string.name: text_size_hint
string.value: Text size follows phone settings, up to 2×.

string.name: settings_save_failed
string.value: Changed for this session only. Could not save the setting.

string.name: settings_apply_failed
string.value: Could not apply the setting. Try again.

string.name: lab_explanation
string.value: Apps A, B and C connect through a local test server, without NearLink radio. Keep the app on screen to relay messages.

string.name: lab_topology
string.value: Default links: A ↔ B ↔ C. The server passes packets only; each app verifies, stores and acknowledges messages.

string.name: hardware_lab_error
string.value: Connection failed. Check that the test server is running.

string.name: relay_detail_a
string.value: The first device checks the original message signature.

string.name: relay_detail_b
string.value: The second device verifies the message received from A.

string.name: relay_detail_c
string.value: The third device verifies the message forwarded by B.

string.name: relay_detail_duplicate
string.value: The same message reaches C again.

string.name: relay_detail_tampered
string.value: A message with modified content is submitted for verification.

string.name: relay_detail_expired
string.value: A message past its expiry time is submitted for verification.

string.name: relay_detail_error
string.value: One of the verification steps could not finish.

string.name: choose_place_hint
string.value: Find an address on the offline map.

string.name: connection_home_hint
string.value: Connect devices to exchange exercise messages.

string.name: point_scope
string.value: This map contains 40 selected PSP points in central Kraków, not every point in the area.

string.name: waiting_neighbors
string.value: Waiting for another device to connect.

string.name: emulator_transport
string.value: Emulator test · local connection, no NearLink radio

string.name: foreground_notice
string.value: Relaying pauses when you leave the app. On return, it tries to restore the connection.

string.name: diagnostics_intro
string.value: These tests use exercise messages. They do not send official alerts.

string.name: guide_offline
string.value: Saved on this phone. No internet needed.

string.name: about_body
string.value: An exercise prototype for signed alerts and offline protective points. It is not an official warning service.

string.name: relay_automatic
string.value: Verified alerts are relayed automatically while connected.

string.name: message_unavailable
string.value: This alert is no longer current.

string.name: read_save_failed
string.value: The alert is open, but its read status could not be saved.

string.name: receipt_notice
string.value: The sender signed the alert content. Receipt time, previous device and hop count are local test data, not an authenticated route.

string.name: authority_console_hint
string.value: Sign in to publish a custom exercise alert

string.name: authority_intro
string.value: A local exercise console. Publication requires an activation code; selecting device A does not grant access.

string.name: authority_login_title
string.value: Sign in to the demo console

string.name: authority_token_hint
string.value: Code from the local test operator

string.name: authority_token_notice
string.value: The code stays in memory for this session. It is cleared when you sign out or close the app.

string.name: message_language_hint
string.value: The text is signed in this language. Other devices show this original version.

string.name: draft_body_hint
string.value: Describe the situation and what recipients should do.

string.name: authority_publish_hint
string.value: This publishes a signed exercise alert. Connected devices relay it automatically.

string.name: authority_state_signed_out
string.value: Enter the local activation code to continue.

string.name: authority_state_signing_in
string.value: Checking access to the exercise authority…

string.name: authority_state_published
string.value: Signed and queued for nearby devices.

string.name: authority_state_published_waiting
string.value: Signed and saved; waiting for nearby devices.

string.name: authority_state_invalid_token
string.value: The activation code was not accepted.

string.name: authority_state_unavailable
string.value: The local exercise authority is unavailable. Check that the test service is running.

string.name: authority_state_wrong_authority
string.value: This service does not match the trusted exercise authority.

string.name: authority_state_invalid_draft
string.value: Check the title, instructions, area and validity.

string.name: authority_state_too_large
string.value: The alert is too long. Shorten the text and try again.

string.name: authority_state_rate_limited
string.value: Too many requests. Wait a moment before trying again.

string.name: authority_state_request_conflict
string.value: This publication request conflicts with an earlier request. Start a new alert.

string.name: authority_state_storage_failed
string.value: Could not save the signed message. Retry.

string.name: authority_state_invalid_response
string.value: The exercise service returned an invalid response.

string.name: authority_state_verification_failed
string.value: The returned alert could not be verified. It was not published to other devices.

string.name: authority_state_failed
string.value: Publication failed. Check the test connection and try again.

string.name: receipt_authority_source
string.value: Signed by the local exercise authority

string.name: authority_state_request_expired
string.value: The previous publishing attempt expired. Review the message and publish again.

string.name: language_auto_hint
string.value: System follows the phone’s language: Polish on a Polish phone, English otherwise.

string.name: relay_comfort_hint
string.value: Relaying pauses when the screen turns off or you leave the app, so keeping the screen on uses more battery. Vibration follows the phone’s silent mode.
